description: Split question/exclamation punctuation lexically, remove only a terminal ? or ! token from the grammar-visible token count, and capture SAY/SPEAK from the raw current input buffer without adding globals.

replacements.old:
<SETG P-LEN <GETB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS>>
	<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,P-LEN 6>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXSTART> ,W?SEND>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 2 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?AFTER>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 4 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?WITH>>
		   <SETG P-LEN 4>
		   <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 4>)>
	<COND (<ZERO? ,P-LEN> <TELL "I beg your pardon?" CR> <RFALSE>)>
replacements.new:
<SETG P-LEN <GETB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS>>
	<SET LEN <GETB ,P-INBUF 1>>
	<COND (<AND <G? ,P-LEN 0> <G? .LEN 0>
		    <OR <EQUAL? <GETB ,P-INBUF <+ .LEN 1>> 63>
			<EQUAL? <GETB ,P-INBUF <+ .LEN 1>> 33>>>
	       <SETG P-LEN <- ,P-LEN 1>>
	       <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS ,P-LEN>)>
	<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,P-LEN 6>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXSTART> ,W?SEND>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 2 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?AFTER>
		    <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV <+ ,P-LEXSTART <* 4 ,P-LEXELEN>>> ,W?WITH>>
		   <SETG P-LEN 4>
		   <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 4>)>
	<COND (<AND <G? ,P-LEN 1>
		    <OR <EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXSTART> ,W?SAY>
			<EQUAL? <GET ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXSTART> ,W?SPEAK>>>
	       <SET SPTR <GETB ,P-LEXV <+ <* .PTR ,P-LEXELEN> 7>>>
	       <SET SPTR <+ .SPTR <GETB ,P-LEXV <+ <* .PTR ,P-LEXELEN> 6>>>>
	       <SET EPTR <+ .SPTR 1>>
	       <PUTB ,P-LEXV ,P-LEXWORDS 1>
	       <SETG P-LEN 1>)>
	<COND (<ZERO? ,P-LEN> <TELL "I beg your pardon?" CR> <RFALSE>)>
